purpose: Authoritative security, privacy, credential-handling, and payment-access boundaries for Android implementation.

authority.principle: Security behavior must be enforced by implementation and must not be weakened for convenience.

credential_boundary.rule: Sensitive authentication must remain outside V4SH-controlled data and UI handling.

accessibility_service.purpose: Prototype/feasibility mechanism for interacting with the proven USSD payment interface.
accessibility_service.policy_boundary: AccessibilityService must not be treated as a general-purpose automation permission or assumed to be Play Store compliant without separate policy validation.
allowed_behavior: Detect and classify the expected USSD payment interface.
Enter only explicitly approved non-sensitive values into the expected USSD flow.
Stop when a PIN or other sensitive screen is detected.
Stop when the screen is unknown or non-actionable.
forbidden_behavior: Writing arbitrary values into arbitrary editable fields.
Automating unrelated apps or unrelated screens.
Continuing automation after a sensitive screen is detected.
Treating an unknown screen as an actionable payment screen.

payment_access_setup.purpose: Explicitly establish whether required payment access is ready before a payment attempt.
payment_access_setup.rule: The UI must not claim payment access is ready unless the required system capability is actually available.

device_security.rule: Use only security claims that are actually implemented.

device_authentication.allowed_copy_if_implemented: Use your device's screen lock to protect access to V4SH.
device_authentication.do_not_claim_as_active_without_implement: Require device authentication every time V4SH opens.

privacy.allowed_claim: V4SH keeps its local payment records on the device unless a separately implemented feature explicitly states otherwise.
privacy.rule: Privacy copy must match actual implementation. Do not promise infrastructure or behavior that has not been built and verified.

transaction_data.purpose: Provide a useful V4SH history of payments initiated through V4SH.

reference_id.rule: Persist/display only when actually supplied by the payment flow.

sensitive_data_minimization: Store only information required for the local transaction record.
Do not store raw accessibility-tree dumps as transaction history.

network.important: Network availability is not proof of payment readiness or payment success.

no_network.message: V4SH needs a mobile network connection to communicate with the payment service.

dual_sim.rule: If multiple SIMs are available, the user must explicitly select the preferred payment SIM.
dual_sim.single_sim: A single available SIM may be selected automatically.
do_not: Silently switch the user's chosen payment SIM during an active payment.
Claim a SIM is payment-ready without checking the required capability.

app_permissions.principle: Request only permissions required for an actual feature.

camera.request_timing: When QR scanning is initiated or during setup if the product flow requires it.

network.important: Mobile network availability is not an Android runtime permission.

accessibility.user_control: User explicitly enables it through Android settings.

confirmation_rules: UNKNOWN must be used when payment may have been initiated but final status cannot be determined.
CANCELLED is valid only when the user stopped before payment initiation.

processing.meaning: Stop V4SH from waiting on the current screen.

logging_and_debugging.rule: Debug logs must never expose payment credentials or sensitive authentication data.
safe_to_log: Local record identifiers that contain no credential material.

required_checks: No credential fields exist in V4SH payment data models.
No UPI PIN is passed into application state.
No OTP is passed into application state.
No sensitive value is written to logs.
Accessibility automation stops on PIN/sensitive screens.
Unknown payment status does not expose immediate retry.
Security/privacy UI claims match implemented behavior.

implementation_constraints: Security rules take precedence over convenience.
Never weaken PIN/OTP boundaries to make automation appear more complete.
Never use AccessibilityService as a reason to capture credentials.
Never store credentials for later payment.
Never present a local V4SH transaction record as a bank statement.
Never make unsupported privacy or security guarantees.
